original_test_intent: Verify every specified PCIe-related management sensor against the physical slot/root-port/device topology and reconcile its name, description and reading across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: Freeze the SUT's root-complex, slot, riser, switch and endpoint inventory; map each required physical object to stable sensor records; retain complete IB/OOB inventories at aligned timestamps; capture all Web pages; compare identity, type, reading, units, state and thresholds with the owner specification and correlate passive PCIe link/error health without changing configuration.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the PCIe physical-to-sensor topology/specification and resolves whether criteria 3–14 are omitted; an operator confirms the Web mapping and the owner decides the final result.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/BIOS plus CPU root-port, riser, PCIe switch, slot and endpoint identities
Installed/empty applicability and authoritative PCIe sensor specification
Physical-object-to-SDR/Sensor/Web mapping for every required record
Sensor type, units, expected normal state/value, thresholds, unavailable/stale semantics and update interval
Expected PCIe link width/speed and permitted error baseline for passive correlation
Approved secure IB/OOB paths and complete Web capture method
Sampling/cache/rounding/pagination policy and decision on missing criteria 3–14
Preserved-log policy and PCIe/BMC escalation owner
safety_requirements: Keep this row passive; do not reset links, hot-plug devices, retrain PCIe or write sensors/thresholds
Protect credentials and retain complete raw inventories before PCIE filtering
Map every required record to an exact physical object; do not accept a generic PCIE name or the test title
Do not truncate output or clear SEL/OS/BMC/AER evidence
Stop on ambiguous topology, missing/duplicate/stale sensor, degraded link, new AER/fatal error or channel mismatch
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity and collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories
Join only owner-approved physical PCIe objects to exact SDR/Sensor/Web records
Normalize fields and correlate passive enumeration, link width/speed and AER/error health
Produce per-object discrepancies and complete Web evidence
Perform no reset, hotplug, retrain, sensor write, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve full PCIe topology, applicability, sensor mappings and expected semantics
Resolve the criteria-number gap and any omitted PCIe checks
Review every mapped object and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only ipmitool is applicable, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - PCIE'` invents a record and OOB-only/truncated evidence omits source-required channels, Web and topology completeness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using approved secret-safe access, retain full IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list`, select all owner-mapped PCIe records, capture complete Web rows and correlate read-only topology/link/error evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, PCIE view, BMC Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute estimates remain; log clearing is withheld.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a versioned graph from root ports through switches/risers/slots to endpoints, attach each management sensor, and compare all IB/OOB/Web representations with passive link/error health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit physical attribution, population completeness and link-state correlation without performing any active PCIe operation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic sensor value cannot show that every installed slot/endpoint is represented or that a reading belongs to the correct root port; it also misses degraded link and duplicated-record errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may expose aggregate rather than per-slot sensors and naming can shift with population; the owner must define grouping and applicability.

project_override_considerations: Aggregate PCIe sensors are acceptable only when the spec maps their exact coverage. Empty slots and disabled links need explicit applicability states. This sensor check does not authorize hotplug or fault injection.
expected_evidence: Versioned PCIe physical topology/population and sensor specification/map
Complete redacted raw IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps and exits
Complete Web sensor evidence with physical mapping and pagination
Passive PCIe width/speed/AER context, criteria 3–14 decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2014 Wistron-BMC-01034-V002: confirm whether Criteria numbering 1, 2, 15 is only a numbering typo or whether PCIe Criteria 3–14 are missing; if missing, provide exact root-port/riser/switch/slot/endpoint sensor coverage, expected values/states and IB/OOB/Web acceptance mapping.

review_improvement: Replaces a fabricated one-sensor shortcut with physical PCIe topology reconciliation, complete source-channel evidence and explicit escalation of the twelve-number criteria gap.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe sensor names are meaningful only when tied to the physical fabric. A platform may report aggregate switch temperatures, slot presence, cable status or port fault states, and similar labels can map to different branches. Complete inventories plus a physical graph are needed to detect missing/duplicate or misattributed records. Passive link and AER context prevents a nominal sensor reading from hiding degraded enumeration, but active resets are outside this row. Criteria 3–14 cannot be guessed.
